entities.summary: Emanual Davis is an American professional basketball player. As a 6-foot-4-inch (1.93 m) point guard, Davis played college basketball for the Delaware State Hornets in Dover, Delaware. Davis was never drafted by a National Basketball Association team, and played in the Continental Basketball Association (CBA), Italian Basketball League, United States Basketball League and the Atlantic Basketball Association in a span of five years before making it into the NBA. Davis played in six NBA seasons, from 1996 to 1998, then from 1999 to 2003.
